origin.description: Tune the ICU BreakIterator used by the text-boundary functions.
origin.usage: stri_opts_brkiter(type, locale, skip_word_none, skip_word_number, skip_word_letter, skip_word_kana, skip_word_ideo, skip_line_soft, skip_line_hard, skip_sentence_term, skip_sentence_sep)

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: One string: character, line_break, sentence, word, or a custom set of ICU break rules.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: One string. NULL or "" selects the default locale.

arguments.name: skip_word_none
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words that fit none of the other word categories.

arguments.name: skip_word_number
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words that look like numbers.

arguments.name: skip_word_letter
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words that contain letters other than hiragana, katakana, or ideographs.

arguments.name: skip_word_kana
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words that contain kana.

arguments.name: skip_word_ideo
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words that contain ideographs.

arguments.name: skip_line_soft
arguments.text: Logical. Skip soft line breaks, where a break is allowed but not required.

arguments.name: skip_line_hard
arguments.text: Logical. Skip hard, mandatory line breaks.

arguments.name: skip_sentence_term
arguments.text: Logical. Skip sentences that end with ".", ",", "?", or "!", possibly followed by a hard separator such as CR, LF, or PS.

arguments.name: skip_sentence_sep
arguments.text: Logical. Skip sentences that have no terminator and end at a hard separator or at the end of the input.

origin.details: The skip_* settings tell locate-all and split to take no action on that boundary class. Custom rules are one string of RBBI syntax. An omitted skip acts as FALSE.
origin.value: A named list of the settings that were supplied. Omitted skip_* values are absent and behave as FALSE.

translation.description: Break-iterator settings as a dict of the values that were passed.
translation.usage: stri_opts_brkiter(type, locale, skip_word_none, skip_word_number, skip_word_letter, skip_word_kana, skip_word_ideo, skip_line_soft, skip_line_hard, skip_sentence_term, skip_sentence_sep)

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: One string: character, line_break, sentence, word, or custom ICU break rules.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: One string. None or "" selects the default locale. None is not stored.

arguments.name: skip_word_none
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words that fit none of the other word categories.

arguments.name: skip_word_number
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words that look like numbers.

arguments.name: skip_word_letter
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words of letters other than hiragana, katakana, or ideographs.

arguments.name: skip_word_kana
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words that contain kana.

arguments.name: skip_word_ideo
arguments.text: Logical. Skip words that contain ideographs.

arguments.name: skip_line_soft
arguments.text: Logical. Skip soft line breaks.

arguments.name: skip_line_hard
arguments.text: Logical. Skip mandatory line breaks.

arguments.name: skip_sentence_term
arguments.text: Logical. Skip sentences that end with a terminator, possibly followed by a hard separator.

arguments.name: skip_sentence_sep
arguments.text: Logical. Skip sentences that end at a hard separator or at the end of the input without a terminator.

translation.details: Names follow the argument list. An omitted skip is absent, and callers treat that as false. The prefix skip is ambiguous. A longer list warns and keeps the first element. An empty list raises replacement has length zero.
translation.value: A dict of supplied settings. True and False stand for TRUE and FALSE. None stands for NULL and is not stored.
